title.original: RLVE: Scaling Up Reinforcement Learning for Language Models with Adaptive Verifiable Environments
title.zh: RLVE：扩展具有自适应可验证环境的语言模型的强化学习
title.en: RLVE: Scaling Up Reinforcement Learning for Language Models with Adaptive Verifiable Environments

inclusion_reason.zh: RLVE-Gym 提供程序化环境、验证器、难度控制和跨环境训练接口，是可扩展的可验证 RL 环境基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: RLVE-Gym provides procedural environments, verifiers, difficulty control, and shared training interfaces as scalable infrastructure for verifiable RL.

abstract.zh: RLVE 让可验证环境按当前策略能力动态调整题目难度，并以 RLVE-Gym 的大规模程序化环境集合研究环境数量对通用推理的扩展效应。
abstract.en: RLVE lets verifiable environments adapt problem difficulty to the current policy and uses the large procedural RLVE-Gym suite to study how environment breadth scales general reasoning.

problem.zh: 静态题目分布会随着策略进步变得过易，或一开始就过难，导致可验证奖励迅速失去有效学习信号。
problem.en: Static problem distributions become too easy as a policy improves or remain too hard initially, causing verifiable rewards to lose useful learning signal.

approach.zh: 每个环境程序化生成问题并算法验证奖励，同时根据策略表现更新难度分布；训练时联合采样多个环境以扩大技能覆盖。
approach.en: Each environment procedurally generates problems and verifies rewards algorithmically while updating its difficulty distribution from policy performance; training jointly samples many environments.

system_design.zh: RLVE-Gym 提供环境注册表、生成器和验证器，难度控制器读取近期成功率调整采样，统一 rollout 与训练层跨环境汇总轨迹。
system_design.en: RLVE-Gym provides an environment registry, generators, and verifiers; a difficulty controller adjusts sampling from recent performance, and shared rollout and training layers aggregate trajectories across environments.

key_results.zh: 环境集合扩展带来持续的跨基准推理提升，联合自适应训练优于继续沿用原有静态 RL 数据分布。
key_results.en: Expanding the environment collection yields consistent cross-benchmark reasoning gains, and joint adaptive training outperforms continuing on the original static RL distribution.

limitations.zh: 大量环境依赖人工工程和可靠验证器，生成分布仍可能与真实任务脱节；难度适配也可能追逐短期指标而忽略技能多样性。
limitations.en: The large suite depends on manual environment engineering and reliable verifiers, generated tasks can diverge from real use, and difficulty adaptation may chase short-term scores over skill diversity.

baselines: continuation of the model's original RL training

metrics.name: Average improvement from continued original RL training
metrics.baseline: continuation of the original RL recipe

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
